nodes.label: Docker: Dev Infra + Production Containerization — Design
nodes.norm_label: docker: dev infra + production containerization — design

nodes.label: postgres (dev)
nodes.rationale: Postgres 16 service for local development. Exposes port 5432 to the host so developers can connect directly; the prod variant omits port mappings to keep the database internal to the compose network.

nodes.label: redis (dev)
nodes.rationale: Redis 7 service used for caching and as the BullMQ queue backend; port exposed locally for development.

nodes.label: minio (dev)
nodes.rationale: S3-compatible object storage for local development, exposing the API (9000) and console (9001). Stands in for a managed S3 bucket in production.

nodes.label: minio-init (dev)
nodes.rationale: Ephemeral one-shot mc container that waits for MinIO to be healthy, creates the bucket if missing, and sets an anonymous download policy. Exists so the app has a ready S3 bucket without manual setup.

nodes.label: mailpit (dev)
nodes.rationale: Local SMTP capture server and mail UI for development. Present only in dev; production uses real SMTP_* env vars instead of a mail-capture service.

nodes.label: postgres (prod)
nodes.rationale: Production Postgres 16. Unlike dev, no host ports are published so the database stays internal to the compose network.

nodes.label: minio (prod)
nodes.rationale: Production object storage, no published ports; accessed internally by api and worker via S3_ENDPOINT http://minio:9000.

nodes.label: minio-init (prod)
nodes.rationale: One-shot bucket bootstrap container that creates the MinIO bucket and sets the anonymous download policy before the application uses object storage.

nodes.label: redis (prod)
nodes.rationale: Production Redis 7, no published ports; serves as the BullMQ queue backend reached internally by api and worker.

nodes.label: migrate (prod)
nodes.rationale: One-shot migrator container (restart: no, Dockerfile target 'migrator') that runs database migrations against postgres before api and worker start. api/worker gate on it via service_completed_successfully.

nodes.label: api (prod)
nodes.rationale: Production HTTP API built from the monorepo Dockerfile target 'runner'. Connects to postgres (DATABASE_URL), redis (REDIS_HOST), and minio (S3_ENDPOINT); publishes PORT and exposes /api/v1/health for healthchecks.

nodes.label: worker (prod)
nodes.rationale: Background BullMQ worker built from the same 'runner' image as api but started with 'node dist/main-worker.js'. Processes queued jobs; shares the same DB/Redis/S3/mail configuration as api.
